Name: Cryptids of Stardew Valley
Author: VinillaBean
Description:
Looking to spook up your game in time for the Halloween season? Consider adding these ~* terrifying *~ cryptids to your game! This mod won second place in the October 2023 Stardew Valley Discord mod jam!~

[color=#8e7cc3][size=4][b]About[/b][/size][/color]
This mod adds five new creatures to the game through [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8626]Custom Companions[/url], all adapted from real life cryptids. Each one has a unique spawn location and time.

Below is a list of all the cryptids and their encounter conditions:
[spoiler][b]Flatwoods Monster[/b]
Location: Backwoods
Time: 6pm-8pm

[b]Mothman[/b]
Location: outside Joja Mart
Time: 10pm-2am

[b]Chupacabra[/b]
Location: Marnie's animal pen
Time: 8pm-10pm

[b]Death Worm[/b]
Location: near Sandy's shop in the Calico Desert
Time: All day

[b]Loch Ness Monster[/b]
Location: Mountain Lake
Time: All day[/spoiler]

[color=#e69138][size=4][b]Configuration[/b][/size][/color]
This mod offers a few different config options so you can customize your spooks exactly how you want them! You can tweak this by either editing your config.json (found in the [CP] folder of the mod) in an application such as Notepad or by using the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] mod.
[list]
[*][b]Seasonal Conditions[/b]: offers two options, [b]YearRound[/b] or [b]FallOnly[/b]. Set to [b]FallOnly[/b] by default.
[*][b]Rarity[/b]: offers two options, [b]Common[/b] and [b]Rare[/b]. Set to [b]Rare[/b] by default.[b] Common[/b] allows all cryptids to spawn, just as long as you are in the correct time and location. [b]Rare[/b] gives each cryptid only a 10% chance to spawn each day.
[*]Each cryptid also has a setting to turn their spawn on or off, in case you have a phobia or general dislike of that particular design! All are set to [b]true[/b] by default, set to [b]false[/b] if you want to remove a particular creature.
[/list]
[color=#8e7cc3][size=4][b]Installation and Removal[/b][/size][/color]
Can be installed like any other mod, by downloading and unzipping into your Mods folder. Can be removed at any time.
[color=#e69138]
[size=4][b]Future Plans[/b][/size][/color]
More cryptids? Conversation topics for the villagers to comment on the cryptids? Creaturebook feature? We'll see!

This mod has also not been tested with map overhauls, such as SVE and SVR3. If you use either of these mods, or any others that change the layout of a map where the cryptids spawn, please let me know if you run into any compatibility issues and I can try to fix it for a future update.
[color=#8e7cc3]
[size=4][b]Credits[/b][/size][/color]
Void for their [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17154]Weird UI [/url]used in the screenshots
DaisyNiko for their [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255]Earthy Recolor[/url] also featured in the screenshots
Doragoun for a boost of inspiration for some dialogue!
The rest of my friends for encouraging me and giving positive feedback!
